title: Native SQLite backup and explicit recovery for Dactyl
intent: Implement a Dactyl-native, explicit, auditable SQLite storage maintenance contract for live backup, integrity verification, dump-reload recovery, and atomic activation while preserving the existing local/remote abstraction boundary and request/response behavior. Inspect the current adapters and tests first; prefer an additive typed contract only if necessary. Preserve original stores until a verified replacement is ready, distinguish healthy, unavailable/locked, and corrupt outcomes, document WAL/SHM and journal-mode semantics, and leave arbitrary external writers and unreliable filesystems outside the guarantee boundary. Do not modify Decapod unless a strictly necessary compatible integration change is proven.
stop_conditions: Stop before adding a cross-process lock-file protocol or Decapod change; the existing Decapod coordination boundary is sufficient for this focused Dactyl contract.
